papers.title_zh: 关闭 Poppy 人形机器人的循环：具有线性二次控制和学习成本函数的双足运动
papers.summary_zh: Poppy Humanoid 是一款开源、低成本的机器人，适用于人工智能研究和教育。然而，我们不知道有任何已发布的方法可以在标准 Poppy 硬件上实现可靠、无辅助的双足运动。本文基于用于轨迹跟踪的线性二次调节器（LQR）框架，为 Poppy 提供了一种功能性闭环行走控制器。从标称行走轨迹的开环回放收集的数据开始，我们提出的方法学习 LQR 控制器的二次成本函数，从而大大提高了运动的可靠性。闭环控制器经过实证验证，与开环轨迹回放相比，步行性能在统计上有显着改善。

papers.title: RTNav: Towards Real-Time Zero-Shot Object Navigation
papers.summary: Navigation in unknown environments to find unforeseen objects has become increasingly feasible with capable vision and language foundation models. However, these models also introduce non-negligible inference latency, which becomes an important concern when agents must operate continuously in the real world. Most state-of-the-art methods are still developed in synchronous simulators, where the environment waits for the agent to act and inference time is effectively free. As a result, agents are often designed around the sequential execution of perception, reasoning, and action, with little regard for time constraints. Under real-time execution, where wall-clock time counts towards the task budget, the inefficiencies of these architectures become clear. We show that recent zero-shot object navigation methods suffer consistent performance degradation under such realistic timing conditions. Motivated by this observation, we propose RTNav, a simple but effective architecture that treats inference latency, asynchronous environment stepping, and bounded compute as explicit design considerations. Evaluated on real-time variants of HM3D-v1, HM3D-v2, and HM3D-OVON, RTNav improves the success rate by up to 11% and the Success weighted by Completion Time by up to 5.1 points over prior work.
papers.title_zh: RTNav：迈向实时零射击对象导航
papers.summary_zh: 借助强大的视觉和语言基础模型，在未知环境中导航以寻找不可预见的物体变得越来越可行。然而，这些模型也引入了不可忽略的推理延迟，当智能体必须在现实世界中持续运行时，这成为一个重要的问题。大多数最先进的方法仍然是在同步模拟器中开发的，其中环境等待代理采取行动，并且推理时间实际上是免费的。因此，代理通常是围绕感知、推理和行动的顺序执行来设计的，很少考虑时间限制。在实时执行下，挂钟时间计入任务预算，这些架构的低效率变得显而易见。我们表明，最近的零样本对象导航方法在这种现实的时序条件下会遭受持续的性能下降。受这一观察的启发，我们提出了 RTNav，这是一种简单但有效的架构，它将推理延迟、异步环境步进和有界计算视为显式设计考虑因素。通过对 HM3D-v1、HM3D-v2 和 HM3D-OVON 的实时变体进行评估，与之前的工作相比，RTNav 将成功率提高了 11%，按完成时间加权的成功率提高了 5.1 个百分点。

papers.title: Shared Actors Need Not Share Critics: Effects of Value Mismatch in Parallel Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: When a single policy is trained in parallel across multiple environments of the same task, such as procedurally generated levels, randomized dynamics, or curricula, implementations commonly use one critic across all sampled environments. Yet different environments can assign different expected returns to the same input visible to the critic. A critic without environment information must then reconcile distinct value targets, systematically shifting the sampled advantages within individual environments. Using illustrative bandit models with multiple environments and a common optimal arm, we characterize how this value mismatch redistributes sampled policy updates, reinforcing unhelpful actions while attenuating or even reversing useful ones. The oracle processes using no baseline, the shared value, or the value specific to the sampled environment have the same mean logit update at a fixed policy and converge to the same optimal policy, yet their realized learning paths can differ sharply. The analysis motivates a minimal intervention: give only a logged environment index to the critic so that it can separate the value targets. Controlled CartPole and MuJoCo experiments expose the predicted shifted values, advantages, and performance gaps. In the more complex BipedalWalker and Procgen settings, the same intervention yields more stable learning and higher returns. Across all $16$ Procgen games, the multihead conditional critic improves aggregate normalized return on $600$ unseen levels per game by $40.8\%$. In conclusion, the theory identifies value mismatch as a direct mechanism through which critic sharing can degrade stochastic learning dynamics, not captured by scalar estimator variance alone, and the experiments show that conditioning on an index is broadly effective in parallel reinforcement learning.
papers.title_zh: 共享参与者不需要共享批评者：并行强化学习中价值不匹配的影响
papers.summary_zh: 当单个策略在同一任务的多个环境中并行训练时，例如程序生成的级别、随机动态或课程，实现通常在所有采样环境中使用一个批评家。然而，不同的环境可以为批评者可见的相同输入分配不同的预期回报。没有环境信息的批评家必须协调不同的价值目标，系统地转移个体环境中的采样优势。使用具有多个环境和共同最优臂的说明性强盗模型，我们描述了这种价值不匹配如何重新分配采样的策略更新，加强无益的行动，同时削弱甚至逆转有用的行动。不使用基线、共享值或特定于采样环境的值的预言机进程在固定策略下具有相同的平均 Logit 更新，并收敛到相同的最优策略，但它们实现的学习路径可能截然不同。该分析激发了最小的干预：仅向批评者提供记录的环境索引，以便它可以分离价值目标。受控 CartPole 和 MuJoCo 实验揭示了预测的偏移值、优势和性能差距。在更复杂的 BipedalWalker 和 Procgen 设置中，相同的干预会产生更稳定的学习和更高的回报。在所有 $16$ Procgen 游戏中，多头条件批评器将每场游戏 $600$ 未见级别的总归一化回报提高了 $40.8\%$。总之，该理论将价值不匹配视为一种直接机制，批评者共享可以通过这种直接机制降低随机学习动态性，而不能仅通过标量估计方差来捕获，并且实验表明，对索引的调节在并行强化学习中广泛有效。
